name: Atom 151 TWS Earbuds
subtitle: Blue wireless earbuds with 30-hour playback
description: Atom 151 TWS Earbuds are blue Bluetooth wireless earbuds with touch controls, low-latency mode, voice assistant support, and up to 30 hours of total playback with the charging case. IPX4 splash and sweat resistance adds protection for workouts and everyday outdoor use.
story: These earbuds combine a compact true wireless design with features suited to music, calls, videos, and gaming. Low-latency mode is intended to improve audio synchronization during compatible content, while touch controls handle playback and calls without reaching for your device. Bluetooth 5.0 provides wireless connectivity, and the USB-C charging port supports recharging the case. The supplied blue finish and IPX4 splash and sweat resistance make them a practical option for daily listening and active routines.

specs.controls: Touch controls for playback and calls
specs.playback_time: Up to 30 hours with charging case
specs.voice_assistant: Compatible with Siri and Google Assistant
